connector.name: Veracium
connector.registryDescription: Provenance-aware memory for AI agents: quarantine, abstention gate, supersession-with-history.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package veracium. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the veracium-ai account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
env.description: API key for the reference Anthropic provider

env.name: VERACIUM_DB_PATH
env.description: Path to the SQLite memory file (default: veracium.db)

env.name: VERACIUM_USER
env.description: Default user id when a tool call omits user_id
